column1: # Suhalla Gate checkpoint: travel papers, Colosso guards, Iodem's arrival and the wounded soldiers.

column3: Only travelers with\nproper papers may pass.\nShow them, or turn back.{end_wait}
Are you heading to\nBabi Lighthouse?{end_now}

I do not question why
Babi ordered us to guard
this passage.{page_break}I follow his orders.
That is what a soldier
is expected to do.{end_wait}

I wonder whether
Colosso has finished
for the year.{page_break}I would have liked to
see it. Perhaps next
year...{end_wait}
What is the meaning\nof this!?{end_wait}

I cannot get up...
I do not think I can
stand.{page_break}Please, send help from
Babi Lighthouse when
you reach it.{end_wait}

A Colosso victor should
not have to suffer
like this.{page_break}When I find those
responsible, I will
settle the score.{end_wait}

Damn it... I cannot bear
to let Iodem see me
like this.{page_break}I would rather hide
than face him in this
condition.{end_wait}

I thought I was dead.
I can hardly believe
I survived.{page_break}Those strange men with
wild hair overwhelmed
us with their power.{end_wait}
Uh...{pause_20_skippable} Is...{pause_20_skippable}\nIs that Iodem...?{end_wait}
What happened here\nat the gate?{end_wait}
A group of strangers\ncame... They had no\npapers, but tried to pass.{end_wait}
I-Io{pause_20_skippable}dem...{end_wait}
We tried to stop them...{pause_20_skippable}\nbut they were too strong!{end_wait}
They{pause_20_skippable} wielded strange\npowers...{pause_20_skippable} We never\nstood a chance.{end_wait}
It had to be {actor_name:5}!{end_now}
No one else could have\ndone this...{end_wait}
You know your own enemy,\nIodem. Who else could\nhave done this?{end_wait}
Once we find {actor_name:7},\nwe must hunt down the\nmonsters who did this.{end_wait}
We must reach Babi\nLighthouse at once!{end_wait}
Yes{pause_20_skippable}, but we cannot\nleave the soldiers\nhere...{end_wait}
We're all right.{pause_20_skippable} Don't\nworry about us. Please,\ngo after them...{end_wait}
But we can't just...{end_wait}
We lost the fight, but\nwe'll survive.{pause_20_skippable} Now go!{end_wait}
If they've done anything\nto the lighthouse... I...{end_wait}
He's right. We have to\nstop them!{end_wait}
We're going after them,\naren't we, {actor_name:1}?{end_wait}
